results.reasoning: ③led → leading. 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 = leading to. ①known(과거분사후치수식), ②sitting(현재완료진행형), ④shaking(동명사) 적절.
④curing → cured. cannot be + p.p. 수동태. ①Dealing(동명사주어), ②nearly(부사), ③considered(수동태) 적절.
①common → commonly. 부사가 동사 occurs 수식. ②lying(현재분사), ③challenging(형용사보어), ④done(수동태) 적절.
②what → that. the fact _____ RLS cannot be cured = 동격절 접속사 that. ①to move(to부정사형용사적), ③might(조동사), ④manage(help+O+원형) 적절.
③intensify → relieve. 증상을 완화(relieve)해야 함. intensify(강화)는 반대. ①experience, ②commonly, ④permanent 적절.
①effortless → challenging. 심각한 RLS는 더 힘든(challenging). effortless(수월)는 반대. ②impossible, ③mystery, ④manage 적절.
'Why RLS happens is still a mystery' → 원인 미스터리 = 아직 밝혀지지 않음 → T.
'permanent condition + no cure' → 영구적이며 치료 불가. '일시적이라 자연 치유'는 반대 → F.
'make sitting through a movie or a long flight nearly impossible' → 장시간 앉기 거의 불가능 → T.
can relieve their _____ by walking → symptoms(증상). cure/mystery/condition 부적절.
It might be _____ → a genetic condition(유전적 질환). permanent(뒤에별도언급), neurological(앞에정의됨), mild case(부적절).
'no cure' + 'medicines to manage symptoms' → 완치법없지만 증상관리약 있다 일치. ①운동시발생반대, ②방법없다반대, ③유전확인아닌might.
③ 수면문제→활력증가? → 원문 'leading to daytime tiredness(주간피로)'. 불일치. ①②④ 일치.
② have been sat → have been sitting. 현재완료진행형 be + V-ing. ①③④ 어법 정상.
'relieve their symptoms / manage their symptoms' → 질병의 징후 = symptoms. 1단어.
'Why RLS happens is still a mystery' → 설명되지 않은 것 = mystery. 1단어.

results.wa: the fact that RLS cannot be cured doesn't mean nothing can be done
results.reasoning: the fact that(동격접속사)+RLS cannot be cured+doesn't mean+nothing can be done. 13단어.
본문 핵심: RLS 증상(itchiness/burning)+원인(mystery/genetic)+치료한계(no cure/manage). 주제 = 하지불안증후군의 증상, 원인, 치료 한계.
요지: no cure + 'doesn't mean nothing can be done' + medicines to manage. = RLS는 완치 불가이지만 증상 관리 방법은 있다.
